quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.intro: Add several buys at once. They are saved together: if one row has a problem, nothing is saved. To spread an amount, fill in the amount and a share for each row, then press Split the amount; you can still change the units.
quickAdd.amountHint: Optional. Only used by Split the amount.

errors.empty: Fill in at least one row.
errors.units: Row {{n}}: enter whole units, at least 1.
errors.price: Row {{n}}: enter the price paid, more than zero.
errors.fees: Row {{n}}: the fees must be a number.

reconcile.title: Reconcile with your broker
reconcile.hover: Checks that Folio agrees with your broker. Paste the holdings your broker shows for a date (an ISIN and the units on each line). Folio works out your units on that date from your transactions and lists, for every holding, whether they match. Nothing is changed or saved; a difference usually means a transaction is missing, duplicated or on the wrong date.
reconcile.intro: Paste the holdings your broker shows for a date, one per line with the ISIN and the number of units. Folio lists the differences with its own records. Nothing is changed.
reconcile.pasteHint: An ISIN and a quantity on each line, separated by a tab, semicolon or spaces.
reconcile.nothing: Paste at least one line with an ISIN and a quantity.

reports.disclaimer: These figures come straight from your transactions and the lots they used. They support your tax return; they are not tax advice, and the rules that apply to you are yours to check.

empty.title: No reports yet
empty.body: Reports appear once you have recorded a sale, a dividend or interest.

tax.title: Tax support for {{year}}
tax.caption: Figures for {{year}} for a tax return
tax.partial: The year is not over: the figures run to {{end}}.
tax.unvalued: {{count}} holding(s) had no price on one of the dates, so they are missing from the values.
tax.flowHint: As the returns count external flows: purchases and deposits in, sales and withdrawals out.
tax.withholding: Tax and fees withheld on income

empty.title: No transactions yet
empty.body: The tax-support report needs at least one transaction.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.help: Every posted transaction, one row each, in the layout the import wizard recognises: import the file again (into a new account, for example) and the positions come out the same.

positions.title: Positions
positions.help: The open positions with their cost basis, market value and last close.

projection.intro: A simulation of what your portfolio could be worth if returns were random with the expected return and volatility you choose, and you add the monthly amount you choose. It is an illustration of your assumptions, not a forecast.
projection.invalid: Fill in every assumption with a number; the horizon is 1 to 40 whole years.
projection.measured: For reference, from {{start}} to {{end}} your portfolio returned {{ret}} a year with a volatility of {{vol}}.
projection.table: Projected value of the portfolio by month
projection.assumptions: Assumptions: start {{start}}, {{contribution}} a month, {{ret}} % expected return and {{vol}} % volatility a year, {{years}} years, {{paths}} simulated paths.
projection.summary: On {{date}} the median is {{median}}, and 8 times in 10 the value would be between {{low}} and {{high}}.

backups.title: Backups and restore
backups.intro: Folio makes a verified backup every night and keeps the recent ones on the server. Here you can make one now, download one, bring one in from elsewhere, and restore one.
backups.lastOk: The last restore, of {{source}} on {{at}}, worked.
backups.lastFailed: The last restore, of {{source}}, did not work and changed nothing: {{error}}
backups.withKeys: Include the saved API keys (they stay encrypted)
backups.caption: Backups on the server
backups.downloadNote: A download leaves out your saved API keys, so a copy that leaves the server does not carry them. A restore of such a file needs the keys entered again.

upload.title: Bring in a backup
upload.help: A backup file made by Folio elsewhere. It is checked and kept on the server; nothing is restored until you choose to.

warn.replace: Everything in Folio is replaced by what is in that backup: transactions, settings, strategies, recommendations.
warn.kept: What is there now is kept as a "before a restore" backup, so this can be undone by restoring that one.
warn.restart: Folio restarts to do it, which takes about a minute.
warn.signedOut: You are signed out and sign in again with the password (and the second factor) the backup had.
warn.keys: A backup made without the API keys brings no keys back: enter them again.
